title: Paul McCartney live: Palau Sant Jordi, Barcelona | 1993
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Palau Sant Jordi in Barcelona, Spain, on 27 October 1993.

It was the 64th night of the New World Tour, which lasted for 77 dates across 19 countries between February and December 1993, and the second of two consecutive nights in Barcelona.

McCartney’s band was Linda McCartney on vocals, keyboards, and percussion; Hamish Stuart on guitar, bass guitar, and vocals; Robbie McIntosh on guitar and vocals; Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens on keyboards and vocals; and Blair Cunningham on drums and percussion.

McCartney returned to the Palau Sant Jordi on 28 and 29 March 2003, during the Back In The World Tour.
